name: Keep Supabase Alive

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 */3 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  ping:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Write to Supabase (real activity, not just a read)
        run: |
          curl -s -o /dev/null -w "Supabase heartbeat response code: %{http_code}\n" \
            -X PATCH \
            "https://xrxcrrifadwvgknxleeb.supabase.co/rest/v1/keep_alive?id=eq.1" \
            -H "apikey: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InhyeGNycmlmYWR3dmdrbnhsZWViIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODc1MDkxOTAsImV4cCI6MjEwMzA4NTE5MH0.N-mvC0ba1L6pgNvq4yv_isb28FuCrPm_j-RR4PMvH6w" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InhyeGNycmlmYWR3dmdrbnhsZWViIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODc1MDkxOTAsImV4cCI6MjEwMzA4NTE5MH0.N-mvC0ba1L6pgNvq4yv_isb28FuCrPm_j-RR4PMvH6w" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Prefer: return=minimal" \
            -d "{\"last_ping\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\"}"

      - name: Log activity (keeps the repo itself active)
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github
          echo "Last keep-alive run: $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')" > .github/keep-alive-log.txt
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .github/keep-alive-log.txt
          git commit -m "chore: keep-alive $(date -u +%F)" || echo "Nothing to commit"
          git push
